verdict.rationale: Apify documents saving multiple input configurations as separate tasks for one Actor (apify-docs-17, apify-docs-25), and inputs include startUrls and crawl limits (apify-docs-15). That lets a developer run different crawl configurations against different URL sets, but only as separate task runs, not as per-URL-pattern rules inside one batch job. Missing for 10: documented per-URL-pattern or route-based configuration within a single run, any example of mixing configurations in one job, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
